gpu_tip: ~43GB total at 128K context — no need to hunt for a giant workstation card. llama.cpp splits dense models layer-by-layer between GPU and CPU, so an 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4060) carries a solid share of the layers at full speed, with ~48GB of ordinary DDR5 system RAM covering the rest.
mac_tip: Needs ~43GB — comfortable on a 64GB MacBook Pro (M4 Pro/Max or M5 Pro/Max); a 48GB config is tight.
